name: Raven Curse
source: Experience the back story of Corvus Raven from the Raven-Saga! In this short visual novel you will learn more about the much-loved gentleman from the Salem of the 17th century and how he became the infamous Corvus Raven. What happened before the events in the books? How does Corvus’s sister Emily feel about her brother’s escapades? And what about the bourgeois girl Rose Barnes from the orphanage? Visit well-known places from the books and get to know your favourite characters better.
translation: 体验乌鸦传奇中乌鸦座乌鸦的背景故事！在这部简短的视觉小说中，你将更多地了解这位来自17世纪塞勒姆的深受喜爱的绅士，以及他如何成为臭名昭著的乌鸦。书中的事件发生之前发生了什么？科沃斯的妹妹艾米丽对她哥哥的越轨行为有何感想？那么来自孤儿院的资产阶级女孩罗丝·巴恩斯呢？参观书中的著名地点，更好地了解你最喜欢的角色。
